ValidationRule.description: Employee Department & Practice Head Department should be Equal.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK( TEXT( Department__c ) )), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT( Practice_Head__r.Department__c ))), TEXT( Department__c ) <> TEXT( Practice_Head__r.Department__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Employee Department & Practice Head Department should be Equal
